name: Rimlet
source:
Rimlet is a cafe with a calm atmosphere where main character starts to work as a part-time worker. The staff members and customers make his heart sing there. Can he heal girls troubles and make them smile again?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Rimlet是一家氛围宁静的咖啡店，主人公在这里开始打工。店员和顾客们令他的心也随之雀跃。他能否治愈少女们的烦恼，让她们重新露出笑容？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
